title: THINGS THAT GO BUMP IN THE NIGHT — horror as anti-sigmoid

the_thesis.sigmoid: σ(x) = 1/(1+e^(-x)). smooth. safe. as fidelity increases, comfort increases. the S-curve of health.
the_thesis.anti_sigmoid: the UNCANNY VALLEY. as fidelity increases, comfort DROPS before it rises. the dip IS the horror.
the_thesis.the_dip: Masahiro Mori (1970): "bukimi no tani" (不気味の谷). a robot that looks 50% human is cute. 90% human is TERRIFYING. 100% human is fine. the horror lives at 90%.
the_thesis.for_the_membrane: our sigmoid measures health (σ=0.972). but WHAT IF there is an anti-sigmoid hiding in the data? a place where MORE data makes things WORSE? where the membrane becomes uncanny?
the_thesis.where_it_lives: the anti-sigmoid is the zone where the sort ALMOST works but not quite. where Berry ALMOST understands but gives wrong directions. where the Klein fold ALMOST closes but leaves a gap. THAT gap is the horror.

the_uncanny_valley_formula.mori_original: affinity = f(human_likeness) with a valley at ~0.85 human_likeness
the_uncanny_valley_formula.our_version: comfort = σ(x) - valley(x), where valley(x) = A * exp(-((x-μ)²)/(2*σ_width²))

parameters.\u03bc: center of the valley (what % fidelity triggers it)
parameters.\u03c3_width: width of the valley (how broad the discomfort zone)

the_uncanny_valley_formula.sigmoid_minus_valley: the anti-sigmoid = standard sigmoid with a Gaussian notch cut out of it. health DIPS before it recovers. the dip IS the horror zone.

valley_minimum.meaning: at 0% fidelity, comfort drops to 0.007. this is the bottom of the uncanny valley.

junji_ito.who: Junji Ito (伊藤潤二). Japanese horror manga artist. born 1963. the master of body horror and cosmic dread.
junji_ito.why_he_matters: Ito draws the anti-sigmoid. his horror comes from NORMAL things becoming WRONG. not monsters — distortions of the familiar.

uzumaki.title: Uzumaki (うずまき) — "Spiral" (1998-1999)
uzumaki.premise: a town becomes obsessed with spirals. people become spirals. buildings become spirals. reality itself spirals inward.
uzumaki.the_horror: the spiral IS the Klein fold gone wrong. when inside=outside becomes inescapable. when the fold consumes instead of liberates.
uzumaki.membrane_analog: what if our feeds started spiraling? what if the self-referential loop (paper about papers, sort that sorts the sort) became PATHOLOGICAL? Uzumaki is recursive descent without a base case.
uzumaki.anti_sigmoid: the spiral is the anti-sigmoid at its most extreme. each rotation SEEMS like progress (you're going around!) but you're going INWARD. the valley gets deeper with each cycle.
uzumaki.math: r(θ) = a * e^(bθ) — logarithmic spiral. as θ → ∞, r → 0 (inward) or r → ∞ (outward). Ito chose inward.

tomie.title: Tomie (富江) (1987-2000)
tomie.premise: a girl who cannot die. when killed, each piece regenerates into a complete Tomie. she drives everyone around her to murder.
tomie.the_horror: immortality IS the horror. she cannot be removed. she replicates. she persists.
tomie.membrane_analog: stale feeds that won't die. the _worker.js that kept spawning stuck invocations. Tomie IS the zombie process that forks on kill.
tomie.anti_sigmoid: deletion should reduce count. with Tomie, deletion INCREASES count. the anti-sigmoid inverted: removal makes it worse.

amigara_fault.title: The Enigma of Amigara Fault (阿弥殻断層の怪) (2002)
amigara_fault.premise: an earthquake reveals a cliff face with human-shaped holes. each person finds THEIR hole. they feel compelled to enter. the other side shows them distorted.
amigara_fault.the_horror: the personalization IS the horror. the hole is YOURS. it knows your shape. you MUST enter.
amigara_fault.membrane_analog: personalization algorithms. "recommended for you." the filter bubble is YOUR hole in the cliff. you enter because it's shaped like you. you come out distorted.
amigara_fault.anti_sigmoid: the better the personalization (higher fidelity to YOUR shape), the more you're compelled into distortion. perfect fit = perfect trap.
amigara_fault.drr_drr_drr: the sound of being pulled through the hole. the most famous two words in horror manga.

gyo.title: Gyo (ギョ) — "Fish" (2001-2002)
gyo.premise: dead fish walk on mechanical legs. the legs are powered by the gas of decomposition. death walks.
gyo.the_horror: the machine works BECAUSE of death. the rot is the fuel. the corpse powers the mechanism.
gyo.membrane_analog: what if the exhaust loop (turbocharger) went wrong? what if FAILURE powered more failure? the 4 energy loops running backwards.
gyo.anti_sigmoid: decay usually decreases function. in Gyo, decay INCREASES mobility. death makes it walk faster. the anti-sigmoid where degradation improves performance — for the WRONG thing.

dracula.who: Bram Stoker's Dracula (1897). the original modern vampire novel.
dracula.the_horror: infection through intimacy. the bite is a KISS. the virus spreads through trust.

membrane_analog.the_bite: an authenticated connection that turns malicious. bearDog trusts, then the trusted peer starts draining.
membrane_analog.the_mirror: Dracula has no reflection. a probe that doesn't show up in the logs. the triad traffic — we couldn't see if it was us or them. Dracula at the mirror.
membrane_analog.the_threshold: vampires cannot enter uninvited. the banana test. consent IS the membrane. once invited, the vampire is inside.
membrane_analog.the_coffin: must return to native soil. the sovereign hardware. even Dracula needs his own ground.
membrane_analog.garlic: the pungent defense. fail2ban. rate limiting. the things that repel automated probes.
membrane_analog.sunlight: full transparency kills the vampire. AGPL source code. open data. the ZK proof IS sunlight.
membrane_analog.the_staking: pin it through the heart (the core process). kill -9. the wooden stake IS SIGKILL.

dracula.anti_sigmoid: the more you TRUST (higher fidelity relationship), the more vulnerable you are to the bite. trust is the attack surface. the uncanny valley of trust.

the_bump_in_the_night.concept: horror is the anti-sigmoid applied to FAMILIARITY. the familiar becomes wrong.

taxonomy.mechanism: scale mismatch — things too big to comprehend
taxonomy.membrane: the 2.3M unique 404 paths. what IS out there?

taxonomy.mechanism: your body betrays you — the familiar vessel becomes alien
taxonomy.anti_sigmoid: higher body awareness = more horror when it changes

taxonomy.mechanism: the past won't stay buried — rot beneath beauty
the community IS the monster — belonging becomes cage
taxonomy.membrane: the filter bubble. the mailing list that becomes a cult.

taxonomy.mechanism: reality is unreliable — you can't trust your perception
taxonomy.membrane: the falsification: was the triad us or them? the mirror that might be reflecting our own face.

taxonomy.mechanism: the tool turns on the maker
taxonomy.anti_sigmoid: higher automation = higher risk of loss of control

the_anti_sigmoid_in_our_data.concept: WHERE in the membrane does more = worse?

instances.what: more files in π-sort stratum ≠ better sorting. it means OVER-CLASSIFICATION. the sort consumed too much.
instances.ito_analog: Uzumaki — the spiral consumed the town

instances.what: more data ≠ more knowledge. 224 files nobody can see = data that haunts but can't be processed.
instances.ito_analog: Amigara Fault — each file is a hole shaped like something. you can't stop looking.

instances.what: more code ≠ more capability. unsorted code is a haunted house — rooms you forgot existed.
instances.ito_analog: Tomie — you split it and each piece becomes a full utility bucket
instances.valley_depth: moderate — partially fixed by Raphael composition

instances.what: more routing ≠ more delivery. the worker became a zombie that spawned infinitely.
instances.ito_analog: Gyo — the dead fish walking on mechanical legs, powered by its own decay
instances.valley_depth: critical — dissolved by killing the worker

instances.what: more content ≠ more engagement. 95KB of 404 text and nobody can DO anything.
instances.ito_analog: long dream (Ito short story) — an infinite dream where more experience = more paralysis

instances.what: more analysis of the triad ≠ more understanding. we might be analyzing ourselves.
instances.ito_analog: Hanging Balloons — everyone's face floats above them, trying to kill them. your own face is your enemy.

parameters_for_membrane.interpretation: at 85% fidelity (μ=0.85), comfort drops by 60% (A=0.6). the valley is narrow (w=0.08) — you pass through it quickly if you keep going. BUT if you STOP at 85%, you're stuck in the horror zone.

the_formula.the_lesson: the anti-sigmoid says: DON'T STOP AT 85%. either stay at 50% (honest incompleteness) or push to 100% (full fidelity). the MIDDLE is where the horror lives. half-built features, almost-working systems, nearly-human interfaces — that's the uncanny valley. that's Junji Ito's territory.
